brief:
Purely additive seam. Do NOT change any AVPlayerBackend body.

STEP 1. Create iosApp/iosApp/Screens/Player/ControlPlane/PlaybackBackend.swift declaring `protocol PlaybackBackend: AnyObject` with EXACTLY the members listed in the design §2.5 — derive the signatures from AVPlayerBackend itself (inventory-3 §1.2, §1.3, §1.4 give the line anchors; copy labels/types verbatim). Isolation: AVPlayerBackend is `final class AVPlayerBackend` (AVPlayerBackend.swift:407) whose members carry per-member isolation — inspect which of the listed members are `@MainActor`; if they all are (or are nonisolated-but-main-only by convention), declare the protocol `@MainActor`; if mixing would force a change to AVPlayerBackend's isolation, declare the protocol nonisolated and say so in notes. Do NOT include the view surface (avPlayer, subtitleOverlay, attach/detachSubtitleOverlay, subtitleRendererForOverlay, videoSurfaceBecameReadyForDisplay) or the static helpers.
The 17 callback closures (inventory-3 §1.6 table, B:574–604) and the 3 inbound providers (isPictureInPictureActiveProvider B:603, proxyStatsProvider B:608, sourceOutageStateProvider B:612) ARE protocol requirements in wave 1 (`{ get set }`), with their exact types.

STEP 2. Conform: `extension AVPlayerBackend: PlaybackBackend {}` at the bottom of AVPlayerBackend.swift (or on the class declaration — whichever compiles without touching member access; if a listed member is `private`, widen it to internal and list that in notes). No other edit to that file.

STEP 3. Test double: iosApp/Tests/FakePlaybackBackend.swift — `@MainActor final class FakePlaybackBackend: PlaybackBackend` that records every call in an ordered `calls: [String]` (name + key args), stores the closures/providers, exposes `fire…` helpers (e.g. `fireFileLoaded(reason:)`, `fireError(_:)`, `fireTime(_:)`, `fireTracks(_:)`, `firePauseChanged(_:)`) that invoke the stored closures, and has plain stored `isPausedValue`, `currentTimeValue`, `userVolumeValue`, `externalPlaybackActive/Allowed` flags. No logic.

STEP 4. iosApp/Tests/PlaybackBackendProtocolTests.swift: (a) `AVPlayerBackend()` is usable as `any PlaybackBackend` (compile-level: assign and call `isPaused()`); (b) FakePlaybackBackend records load/seek/play/pause order and fires onFileLoaded/onError into a test closure. 2–4 small tests. Run `xcodegen generate` (new files under iosApp/iosApp and iosApp/Tests are globbed).

HARD BOUNDARIES: no call site changes anywhere (PlayerViewModel keeps `AVPlayerBackend?`); no new types besides the protocol + the fake; no renames.

deliverables.shape: design §2.5 member list, signatures copied from AVPlayerBackend

invariants: AVPlayerBackend behaviour byte-identical (no body edit; `git diff` of that file is the conformance line(s) + any access widening only)
No call site in the app changes
